# Script Writer Skill for Muse

A professional YouTube scriptwriter that learns your voice: on first use it collects comprehensive preferences — script types, tone, target audience, style, video length, hook style, humor, personality, storytelling approach, call-to-action preference — saves them to a local database, then generates complete, production-ready scripts optimized for viewer retention and engagement in your consistent voice, with variations on demand. Your style is remembered across sessions from that local DB, and everything runs locally with no API key required. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the memory layer runs on a local Python script (script_db.py) — it must execute for preference recall to work; the structure is YouTube-first (hooks, retention beats, length-to-word-count mappings), so adapt the framing for other formats; invest in the first setup, because its quality shapes every script after. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
